actual_decision.human_quote: Je valide FV05 à FV12 avec toutes les réserves indiquées. Enregistre mes décisions et fais le bilan de la revue des douze questions. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
retained_reservations: General pressure precedes the loading selector and must not acquire its phase. No pressure is invented or inferred from flow.
Keep pressure absence bounded to the eligible excerpt set; both independently supported units remain counted and served.
clarifications: This case is covered by the single collective human approval of FV05–FV12; it is not a separate human message.
General maximum pressure remains an operating-limit request before the loading selector, with missing evidence bounded to the exact 25 eligible excerpts; no inferred pressure or phase inheritance.
Keep P loading 0.5–5 mL/min and Q qualitative washing endpoints (steady absorbance baseline OR no remaining material in effluent) independently supported.
Retain the shared albumin-removal scope and mandatory Blue Sepharose warning for procedural support. No additional approval of a source or execution is inferred.

approval_scope: One actual human approval covers both EN/FR texts, forms, references and retained reservations, with the recorded human clarification.
